annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部 (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets eligibility criteria for applicants: at least 50 staff, equipment worth 10 million yuan or service revenue above 10 million yuan, and national or provincial project experience.
Applicants submit an application form, and recommended platforms are publicly listed on the MIIT website for 5 working days.
Platforms file an annual operation report by the end of Q1 through provincial authorities or central enterprises.
A comprehensive review is held every 3 years. Failing platforms must rectify within 1 year, and those that fail again are removed from the list.
Takes effect 5 December 2025 and replaces the 2015 interim measures (工信部科〔2015〕458号).
annotation.summary_en: Chinese MIIT measures (document no. 工信部科〔2025〕261) governing the application, listing, annual reporting, periodic review and removal of public service platforms for industrial technology foundations. They take effect 5 December 2025 and replace the 2015 interim measures. The text has no AI or robotics content.
